messages:
emma: FYI I opened a small PR to tidy up the quotas + pricing examples and refresh SDK snippets for the header rename. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/925
raj: Thanks. Saw the python example still uses `X-Quota-Tier`  can we standardize on `x-redwood-quota` in all snippets?
maria: Also found a broken grafana link in the usage-analytics guide (panel moved). I can update, but want to avoid churn in this PR.
liam: Quick note for support: dashboards sometimes show transient drops when burst credits apply. We should add a one-line FAQ so customers don't open tickets.
sree: Agreed. Put that under "Interpreting sudden cost changes" with a short bullet.
emma: Plan: (1) rename header in all snippets to `x-redwood-quota`, (2) add an SDKv5 minimal migration snippet, (3) add the burst-credit FAQ bullet, (4) leave grafana panel update to a follow-up PR by @maria to keep scope small.
raj: For the SDKv5 snippet, can we show headers passed at the call-level and client-level? Tiny examples are great.
maria: I'll patch grafana URL separately and run the link-checker + l10n after that.
emma: Draft snippets I added:

```python
# client-level header
from redwood import Client
c = Client(headers={"x-redwood-quota": "tier-pro"})
print(c.usage.list(limit=3))

# call-level header
c = Client()
print(c.usage.list(limit=3, headers={"x-redwood-quota": "tier-pro"}))
```

emma: Also added the FAQ text: "Short-lived per-token cost dips can occur while burst credits are applied; metrics normalize over the next billing period. See billing FAQ for details."
docs-bot: link-check queued for branch. Result: 1 failing link (grafana panel). Failing URL: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old-usage/77. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/3129
liam: LGTM for the snippets & FAQ. Good to land without the grafana change.
raj: LGTM. Once maria updates the grafana reference we should re-run the site build and spot-check code block rendering.
maria: Opening follow-up PR to update grafana panel and trigger link checks now. Will paste PR once ready.
emma: Thanks team. Targeting merge later today if link checks pass on the follow-up. :thumbsup:
